title: Aurora Lamp
summary: A fictional product-launch microsite for the Aurora desk lamp: typographic hero, exploded SVG and lighting modes.

cover.alt: The light-modes section as a room at dusk: the Aurora desk lamp lit amber on deep graphite, beside a large 2700 K readout and Ember, Focus and Studio mode pills.

desktop.alt: Launch hero: the word Aurora set large in a warm serif beside a line-drawn desk lamp with a soft amber glow, numbered nav above, on warm paper.

tablet.alt: Tablet hero in two columns: the Aurora headline, temperature line and scroll cue on the left, the lamp drawing with its amber glow on the right.

mobile.alt: Single-column mobile hero: the Aurora title over the 2700 K to 5000 K spec line, with the lamp drawing and amber glow rising from the lower edge.
